quote: The driver of a vehicle within a business or residence district emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision, and upon entering the roadway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on said roadway.

activation.condition: Driver of vehicle in a business or residence district emerges from alley, driveway or building toward sidewalk and roadway.

obligation.description: Stop immediately prior to sidewalk or sidewalk area, yield to pedestrians as necessary to avoid collision, and yield to all approaching roadway vehicles upon entry.

timing.description: Before sidewalk entry and upon roadway entry.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The law gives no distance or time cutoff for the stop location.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as may be necessary to avoid collision
judgment_calls_needed.note: Pedestrian necessity requires the original motion and conflict context.
Approach and precedence require original roadway motion and context.
